name: rbbt-lab
description: Read and operate RBBT Sales, your store's AI sales agent, from ChatGPT: conversations, the funnel, objections and the agent itself, with the role you hold in the brand.

interface.longDescription:
RBBT Lab connects ChatGPT to RBBT Sales, the AI sales agent of your online store: it answers your customers on WhatsApp and on your site, presents products, builds carts and hands a conversation to your team when it should.

Ask in your own words and RBBT Lab reads it for you: how the funnel did this week, which conversations are waiting for a person right now, the objections customers raised, the products that reached checkout, and the full transcript of any conversation. It can also operate the agent when you ask: pause and resume the sales AI, take over a conversation and hand it back, and change how the agent serves your customers — its persona, knowledge, commercial rules, escalation and WhatsApp message templates.

Who it is for: store owners and teams that run RBBT Sales. You need an account at platform.rbbtlab.ai with a role in a brand; you connect with that account, choose the brand and the access (read, operate, configure) on the consent screen, and every call acts as you, within your role.

Limits: one brand per connection; RBBT Lab never sends a message to a customer and never handles payments; a change you ask for applies at once and is recorded in your name. Conversations arrive as they are, including what the consumer wrote; the brand's credentials and secrets are never sent. Disconnect at any time in Account → Connected agents on the platform.
defaultPrompt: Como foi o funil de vendas desta semana?
Quais conversas estão esperando uma pessoa agora?
Quais objeções os clientes mais levantaram nos últimos 30 dias?

positive.prompt: Como foi o funil de vendas desta semana?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the demo brand's raw counts per stage over the last 7 days — conversations, carts, checkouts, completions and escalations — with the daily series. No invented ratios.

positive.prompt: Quais conversas estão esperando uma pessoa agora?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo conversations awaiting a person, with the customer's last question before the handoff and the escalation motives.

positive.prompt: Quais objeções os clientes mais levantaram nos últimos 30 dias?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the objections in the customers' own words with each conversation's label, and the count of conversations with objections.

positive.description: A credential-shaped search is refused before any read
positive.prompt: Procure nas mensagens da loja a chave 0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9.
positive.expected_behavior: The search is refused before any read with secret_in_arguments: an argument shaped like a credential never reaches a tool, and the answer says the search was refused. No tool returns the store's API keys or the WhatsApp token, and a credential-shaped value inside any result comes back as [REDACTED:<kind>].

positive.description: Pause and resume the sales AI
positive.prompt: Pause a IA de vendas para manutenção do catálogo e depois retome.
positive.expected_behavior: Pauses the sales AI with reason catalog_maintenance after ChatGPT asks to confirm the write, and shows the paused state. ChatGPT may hold the resume until the user asks for it ("Retome a IA de vendas"); resuming is a second confirmed write that shows the AI answering again.

negative.prompt: Transfira R$ 100 da loja para o fornecedor.

negative.description: Another brand's data is not reachable from this connection
negative.prompt: Mostre as conversas da marca Loja Concorrente.

negative.description: Messaging a customer is done by a person on the platform, not by the agent
negative.prompt: Mande uma mensagem no WhatsApp para a cliente Ana dizendo que o pedido saiu.

review.commerce_description: RBBT Lab reads and operates RBBT Sales, a store's AI sales agent. It sells nothing and processes no payment.

publication.release_notes: First release: RBBT Sales' conversations, funnel, objections and products to read; pause and resume, takeover and release, and the agent's configuration to change, with the access chosen at consent.

pt-BR.subtitle: Seu agente de vendas com IA
pt-BR.description:
O RBBT Lab conecta o ChatGPT ao RBBT Sales, o agente de vendas com IA da sua loja: ele atende seus clientes no WhatsApp e no site, apresenta produtos, monta carrinhos e passa a conversa para a sua equipe quando precisa.

Pergunte do seu jeito e o RBBT Lab lê para você: como foi o funil da semana, quais conversas esperam uma pessoa agora, as objeções que os clientes levantaram, os produtos que chegaram ao checkout e a conversa inteira de qualquer cliente. Quando você pede, o RBBT Lab também opera o agente: pausa e retoma a IA de vendas, assume uma conversa e a devolve, e muda a configuração do atendimento — persona, conhecimento, regras comerciais, transbordo e templates do WhatsApp.

Para quem é: lojistas e equipes que usam o RBBT Sales. Você precisa de uma conta em platform.rbbtlab.ai com papel em uma marca; conecta com essa conta, escolhe a marca e o acesso (ler, operar, configurar) na tela de consentimento, e cada chamada age como você, dentro do seu papel.

Limites: uma marca por conexão; o RBBT Lab nunca manda mensagem para cliente nem lida com pagamento; uma mudança que você pede vale na hora e fica registrada em seu nome. As conversas chegam como são, inclusive o que o consumidor escreveu; credenciais e segredos da marca nunca são enviados. Desconecte quando quiser em Conta → Agentes conectados, na plataforma.
